reasons: Status is correct: the supplied paragraphs show dangling cross-references (§9.3 to 'the remedies required by Section 20.5', §21.3 treating 'its indemnification obligations' as an Excluded Claim) with no indemnity clause present, confirming the section is absent — a critical gap under INDEMN.

The insertion is placed as directed (immediately after the last warranty paragraph, 19.5, and before the limitation-of-liability section) and is additive only, so no existing customer-favourable language is disturbed.

Substance reaches the preferred position: Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access to Customer Data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; Customer's indemnity is expressly narrowed to Customer-furnished content and Customer's breach of law with a 'no other indemnification obligation' backstop; standard notice/control/cooperation and settlement-consent procedure; customary IP exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

The final sub-paragraph functions as Section 20.5 (infringement remedies), which repairs the §9.3 cross-reference; internal references to 20.1(a) and 20.5 line up with the inserted paragraph order, so numbering on insertion should be confirmed in the final document.
Rationale on the super-cap is sound: §21.3 already excludes indemnification obligations from the liability cap, so the fallback 3× super-cap would be a downgrade and is properly omitted.
Comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, correctly cites the missing section and the dangling cross-references, and explains what was added and why.

Minor, non-blocking drafting nit: the clause introduces 'Vendor Technology' (and relies on 'Affiliates'/'Customer Data'), which are not among the resolved definitions — confirm these are defined in the Agreement or drop 'Vendor Technology' to keep the edit minimal and match the model language ('Services or Deliverables').
